body_markdown:
Winnipeg, Manitoba–(Newsfile Corp. – November 23, 2026) – Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. (NASDAQ: FNUC) (“Frontier”), a nuclear fuel cycle company, announces that on November 18, 2026, it received written notice from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) that Frontier was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it had not timely filed its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (the “Annual Report”) with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) requires listed companies to timely file all required periodic financial reports with the SEC.


The Nasdaq notice has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of Frontier’s securities. Nasdaq has given Frontier 60 calendar days, until January 18, 2027, to submit a plan to regain compliance. **Frontier expects to file the Annual Report before the January 18, 2027 deadline and will submit a compliance plan by that deadline if required.**


If Nasdaq accepts a compliance plan submitted by Frontier, it may grant an exception of up to 180 calendar days from the filing due date, through May 17, 2027, for Frontier to regain compliance. There can be no assurance that Nasdaq will accept any plan submitted by Frontier or that Frontier will regain compliance within any exception period granted. If Nasdaq declines to accept the plan, Frontier may appeal the decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.


Frontier is issuing this release pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(b). Nasdaq advised Frontier that it will be added to Nasdaq’s public list of non-compliant companies beginning five business days after the date of the notice. Nasdaq will also distribute a non-compliance indicator through its market data network and make it available to third-party market data providers.


**About Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc.**


Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. is focused on building a U.S.-based nuclear fuel cycle platform through uranium exploration and development assets, together with targeted investments in Ubaryon Pty. Ltd., a private Australian company developing next generation enrichment technology, and Kadmos Energy Services LLC, a private U.S. company developing small modular light water reactors. Frontier continues to evaluate opportunities in the nuclear fuel cycle that align with its long-term strategic objectives.
